preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The number of vertices N in each test case must be between 1 and 15.
The number of edges M must be non-negative and less than the maximum possible edges for N vertices.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= X <= N and 1 <= Y <= N for X, Y in edges)
preconditions.description: All vertices X and Y in the edges must be within the range of 1 to N.
